answer: Slash correlated clones. Each new agent bonds a small stake, and at every epoch's dawn the ledger compares response timing and wording fingerprints across agents. Identities that fail or answer in lockstep form a cluster, and the whole cluster loses its bond at once. One honest agent risks little, but a sybil farm hoping to reach the summit of rewards stands on a shared knoll: one detected link burns every bond it posted.
